contenders.handicapper_notes: Draws the absolute pole on the Emerald circuit which provides a +2 pt inside barrier bonus. Brings strong Rockhampton/Mackay formlines into this country BM60, including a win two back and a sharp 5th (beaten only 1.75L) in higher BM60 grade on July 25. Nikki Olzard is in peak form (24% win strike-rate) and gets the ideal stalking run in transit (P). Hardest to beat.

Arrives chasing a hat-trick after decisive victories at Blackall (1050m) and Roma (1200m). Possesses sharp early speed (E) and gets valuable weight relief down to 55kg with Amelia Heinrich claiming. Will push forward and take plenty of catching on this track where on-pace runners thrive.

Local Glenda Bell runner who loves this track and trip, having run a cracking 2nd in BM65 company here on June 29 behind Betta Than Presley. Forgive the 5f sprint failure at Middlemount; step back up to 1200m suits her racing pattern perfectly. Drawn ideally in barrier 4 to stalk the early speed.

Highly talented gelding with 3 wins from 4 starts, including a stylish 2.5-length Maiden win on this track in January. Resuming from a 4-month break and drawn widest, but possesses a strong turn of foot and class upside. Live threat if Chris Whiteley can slot in with cover from the awkward gate.

Ran a very good 2nd over this track and trip on June 29 behind The Stone Mason carrying 60.5kg as a short-priced favorite. Drops 5kg down to 55.5kg here with Warwick Satherley retaining the mount. Will need some luck from barrier 9 but has the closing capability (S) to finish into the placings.

Veteran 9yo who ran an improved 2nd over 1400m at Muttaburra last start. Carries a low weight (56kg) and Paul Hamblin is a positive booking, but lacks the high cruising speed of the top fancies over 1200m.
